description: This file contains core utility functions, constants, and setup code for the RGraph JavaScript charting library. It initializes global objects, defines functions for scales, number formatting, canvas handling, and drawing chart background elements. It also includes event handling and registry management for multiple chart objects.

methods.name: RG.getScale
methods.description: Calculates and returns a set of scale values suitable for graph axes based on a maximum value.

methods.name: RG.getScale2
methods.description: Returns an object with detailed scale information (max, min, labels) based on graph properties and configuration.

methods.name: RG.arrayClone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an array or object.

methods.name: RG.arrayMax
methods.description: Finds the maximum numeric value in an array.

methods.name: RG.arrayMin
methods.description: Finds the minimum numeric value in an array.

methods.name: RG.arrayPad
methods.description: Pads an array to a given length with a specified value.

methods.name: RG.arraySum
methods.description: Returns the sum of elements in an array.

methods.name: RG.arrayLinearize
methods.description: Flattens multiple arguments (arrays or values) into a single array.

methods.name: RG.arrayShift
methods.description: Removes the first element from an array and returns the result.

methods.name: RG.arrayReverse
methods.description: Reverses the order of an array.

methods.name: RG.clear
methods.description: Clears a canvas, optionally filling it with a specified color or gradient.

methods.name: RG.drawTitle
methods.description: Draws the title text on a canvas with positioning and styling options.

methods.name: RG.getMouseXY
methods.description: Calculates mouse X/Y coordinates relative to the canvas element during an event.

methods.name: RG.getCanvasXY
methods.description: Gets the absolute position of a canvas element relative to the page.

methods.name: RG.isFixed
methods.description: Determines whether a canvas element is positioned as fixed and returns the fixed element if so.

methods.name: RG.register
methods.description: Registers a chart object for global redraw management.

methods.name: RG.redraw
methods.description: Redraws all registered chart objects, clearing their canvases first.

methods.name: RG.redrawCanvas
methods.description: Redraws all chart objects associated with a specific canvas, optionally clearing first.

methods.name: RG.background.Draw
methods.description: Draws chart background elements such as grid, axes, titles, and background colors.

methods.name: RG.number_format
methods.description: Formats numbers with thousand separators and optional prefix/suffix.

methods.name: RG.drawBars
methods.description: Draws background horizontal bars on chart areas for visual aid.

methods.name: RG.drawInGraphLabels
methods.description: Draws labels inside the graph area with connector lines.

methods.name: RG.fixEventObject
methods.description: Normalizes event object properties across browsers.

methods.name: RG.hideCrosshairCoords
methods.description: Animates hiding of crosshairs coordinate display.

methods.name: RG.draw3DAxes
methods.description: Draws 3D axes on a chart if applicable.

methods.name: RG.strokedCurvyRect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with rounded corners and optional specific corners rounded.

methods.name: RG.strokedCurvyRect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with rounded (curvy) corners on a canvas context.

methods.name: RG.filledCurvyRect
methods.description: Draws a filled rectangle with rounded (curvy) corners on a canvas context.

methods.name: RG.hideZoomedCanvas
methods.description: Animates hiding of a zoomed-in canvas element.

methods.name: RG.addCustomEventListener
methods.description: Adds a custom event listener for an object, stored in internal event registry.

methods.name: RG.fireCustomEvent
methods.description: Triggers a custom event on a chart object, executing associated callback functions.

methods.name: RG.removeAllCustomEventListeners
methods.description: Removes all custom event listeners for a specific object or globally.

methods.name: RG.removeCustomEventListener
methods.description: Removes a specific custom event listener for an object by index.

methods.name: RG.drawBackgroundImage
methods.description: Draws a background image on the canvas as specified by the object's properties, including stretching and alignment.

methods.name: RG.hasTooltips
methods.description: Determines whether a chart object has tooltips enabled or available.

methods.name: RG.createUID
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.add
methods.description: Registers a chart object within internal registry tracking for canvas management.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.remove
methods.description: Removes a chart object from internal registry tracking.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.clear
methods.description: Clears registry, optionally for a specific canvas.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.list
methods.description: Returns a list of types of all registered objects.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.clearByType
methods.description: Removes all registered objects of a specified type.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.iterate
methods.description: Executes a callback function for each object in the registry, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.getObjectsByCanvasID
methods.description: Retrieves all objects associated with a specific canvas ID.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.getFirstObjectByXY
methods.description: Finds and returns the topmost chart object at specified X/Y event coordinates.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.getObjectsByXY
methods.description: Returns all objects at specified X/Y event coordinates.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.getObjectByUID
methods.description: Retrieves a registered object by its UID.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.bringToFront
methods.description: Brings a specified object to the front of the rendering order and optionally redraws.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.getObjectsByType
methods.description: Retrieves all registered objects of a specific type.

methods.name: RG.ObjectRegistry.getFirstObjectByType
methods.description: Retrieves the first registered object of a specific type.

methods.name: RG.getAngleByXY
methods.description: Calculates the angle in radians from a center point to an event X/Y coordinate.

methods.name: RG.getHypLength
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance between two points.

methods.name: RG.getRadiusEndPoint
methods.description: Calculates the endpoint (X/Y) of a radius at a specific angle from center.

methods.name: RG.installEventListeners
methods.description: Installs necessary event handlers for chart interaction, depending on provided properties.

methods.name: RG.pr
methods.description: A functional equivalent of PHP's print_r(), outputs or returns a string representation of an object or array.

methods.name: RG.dashedLine
methods.description: Draws a dashed line between two points on a canvas context.

methods.name: RG.AJAX
methods.description: Creates an XMLHttpRequest and makes a GET request to a URL, executing a callback upon completion.

methods.name: RG.AJAX.POST
methods.description: Executes an AJAX POST request with data payload, invoking callback when response is ready.

methods.name: RG.AJAX.getNumber
methods.description: Fetches data via AJAX and passes a float number to the callback.

methods.name: RG.AJAX.getString
methods.description: Fetches data via AJAX and passes a string to the callback.

methods.name: RG.AJAX.getJSON
methods.description: Fetches JSON data via AJAX and passes a JavaScript object to the callback.

methods.name: RG.AJAX.getCSV
methods.description: Fetches CSV data via AJAX, parses into an array of floats, and passes it to the callback.

methods.name: RG.rotateCanvas
methods.description: Rotates the entire canvas around specified (x, y) by a given angle in radians.

methods.name: RG.measureText
methods.description: Measures text width and height using DOM-generated measurement element, with caching.

methods.name: RG.text2
methods.description: Draws styled text on a canvas, with support for rotation, bounding box, markers, font styling, complex alignment, multi-line, and vertical text.

methods.name: RG.sequentialIndexToGrouped
methods.description: Converts a sequential index to a grouped bar chart's group/index pair.

methods.name: RG.Highlight.rect
methods.description: Highlights a rectangular shape on the chart by drawing a stroked and filled rectangle.

methods.name: RG.Highlight.point
methods.description: Highlights a point (circle) on the chart by drawing a stroked and filled circle.

methods.name: RG.parseDate
methods.description: Parses date strings with flexible formats, similar to Date.parse but with additional keywords such as 'now'.

methods.name: RG.resetColorsToOriginalValues
methods.description: Restores chart object's color properties to their original values, supports custom reset method.

methods.name: RG.path
methods.description: Interprets a custom path description string or array and executes drawing commands on a canvas context.

methods.name: RG.linearGradient
methods.description: Creates a linear gradient with multiple color stops.

methods.name: RG.radialGradient
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient with multiple color stops.

methods.name: RG.addEventListener
methods.description: Adds an event handler to RGraph's internal registry (not DOM event).

methods.name: RG.clearEventListeners
methods.description: Removes DOM event listeners attached by RGraph from specified canvases or window.

methods.name: RG.hidePalette
methods.description: Hides the annotation palette element.

methods.name: RG.random
methods.description: Generates a random number between min and max, with optional decimal places.

methods.name: RG.random.array
methods.description: Creates an array of random numbers.

methods.name: RG.noShadow
methods.description: Disables shadows on a chart object by resetting shadow properties.

methods.name: RG.setShadow
methods.description: Sets shadow properties (color, offset, blur) for a chart object.

methods.name: RG.Registry.set
methods.description: Stores a value in RGraph's internal registry, using a normalized name.

methods.name: RG.Registry.get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from RGraph's internal registry, using a normalized name.

methods.name: RG.Registry.set
methods.description: Stores a value in the internal registry with a normalized name, ensuring 'chart.' prefix.

methods.name: RG.Registry.get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the internal registry using a normalized name with 'chart.' prefix.

methods.name: RG.degrees2Radians
methods.description: Converts degrees to radians for canvas angle measurements.

methods.name: RG.log
methods.description: Calculates the logarithm of a number with an optional base.

methods.name: RG.isArray
methods.description: Checks whether a given object is an array.

methods.name: RG.trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from both ends of a string.

methods.name: RG.ltrim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from the start of a string.

methods.name: RG.rtrim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from the end of a string.

methods.name: RG.isNull
methods.description: Checks whether a variable is null or undefined.

methods.name: RG.async
methods.description: Executes a function asynchronously after a short delay.

methods.name: RG.reset
methods.description: Resets a canvas element, clears all associated chart objects from registry, and resets translation state.

methods.name: RG.getCanvasTag
methods.description: Retrieves the canvas DOM element and ID from a given ID or element object.

methods.name: RG.Effects.updateCanvas
methods.description: Encapsulates requestAnimationFrame for smooth animations.

methods.name: RG.Effects.getEasingMultiplier
methods.description: Calculates easing multipliers for animations, giving a smooth out effect.

methods.name: RG.stringsToNumbers
methods.description: Converts string or array representations of numbers into actual numbers, supporting CSV and quoted formats.

methods.name: RG.cachedDraw
methods.description: Caches drawing operations on an off-screen canvas to optimize rendering performance.

methods.name: RG.parseObjectStyleConfig
methods.description: Recursively parses a configuration object and applies style settings to chart objects.

methods.name: RG.path2
methods.description: Implements a path parser to execute drawing commands on a canvas context, supporting a custom mini-language for shape drawing.
